data.title: 在原七海 · 站台上的等候
data.description: 列车还要等几分钟，七海站在站台边查看路线。她把票收回包里，抬头寻找下一班车的信息。
data.action: holding a ticket and looking at the platform sign
data.promptProse: Standing on an open-air commuter train platform in early morning, Nanami holds a small train ticket, looking upward toward an electronic overhead departure display. Golden dawn sunlight glints off railway tracks extending into the distance, with steel safety railings, yellow tactile paving, and distant power lines crafting a crisp, lively transit atmosphere.
